card.name: Unused or used items to discard
card.fires_on: Adjectives like unused, used, or gray right before a noun for a leftover item (drug, portion, cap, ring) in disposal or handling instructions. The pole responds to the modifier, not the noun.

modes.label: Unused leftovers
modes.description: The word unused after discard or dispose of, before drug, portion or product.
modes.example: Discard any<< unused>> perampanel oral suspension remaining 9

modes.label: Used items
modes.description: The word used before a physical item being handled or reused.
modes.example: The<< used>> ring should be placed in the sachet

modes.label: Other item modifiers
modes.description: A modifier or noun for a leftover or removed part, outside drug disposal.
modes.example: Do not put the<< gray>> needle cap back onto the syringe.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like fresh, recycled and discarded, which suggests a status of an item as new or leftover.
card.plain: It fires on words like unused or used that describe a leftover item right before the item is named, often in throw-away instructions.
